notes: kb/Work PB988 LANDED (wave 1015 Z2). cite.py --check 10.7.3 'then an END PROGRAM marker referencing program-name shall precede the END PROGRAM marker referencing program-name-1' OK 3). The grammar pairs each marker with the innermost open unit, so reversed markers parse; a marker whose name is another unit of the same nesting chain (an open container, or a program this one contains) is COBOL2793 (SR3): END PROGRAM PB988B. END PROGRAM PB988BN. is refused at every edition. pb988_end_markers' contained PB988N's marker precedes PB988M's.
